does: Calls the delegate for every key and value of this dictionary's own table only; merged dictionaries are not walked, so gui::LSImageSequence::OnLoaded sees only the images written inside its own Resources.

evidence.says: macOS pseudo-code: one loop over the hash table at +0x270 (count +0x27c, 0x30 per slot), skipping empty slots; no reference to the merged list
the macOS build's symbols hold this name
NoesisGUIShared.dll exports this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function
